# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an open-source, community-maintained AI workspace for conversations, projects, plugins and local memory. Desktop 5.5.0 includes the official DSH 0.2.3-alpha.2 runtime and Web UI.

## Desktop 5.5.0

- Release tag: desktop-v5.5.0
- Published: 2026-11-26
- Source commit: 34f39ba61c13768eec443b21dcdda699fdbfee5c
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 x64, macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon (Preview), Linux x64 (Preview)
- License: BSD-3-Clause

### Highlights

- Windows in-place upgrades preserve the existing installation, data, conversations and configuration.
- The conversation sidebar focuses on chats and projects. The Extension Dock groups tools, and Community Workshop appears in plugin discovery.
- Windows Setup completes before Shared Browser downloads. The component is prepared on first use.
- Personal Preferences manages local memory by global, project and session scope. Model suggestions are saved after confirmation.
- Work Mode brings office connectors such as Feishu, Tencent Docs, and DingTalk into native conversations.
- ACP v1 connects local agents. Antigravity OAuth is limited to direct local interaction.
